text:
Situation: Strides Pharma Inc. ursodiol capsules are discontinued per FDA's shortage list with an initial posting date of 2026-04-06. Corvale General holds 303 units with a daily use of 9.6 units, providing 32 days on hand. The product label for NDC 00904622161 names Epic Pharma as the manufacturer, though the plant is not placed.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records Strides Pharma Inc. ursodiol capsules as discontinued with an initial posting date of 2026-04-06. The listed reason is discontinuation of the manufacture of the drug.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 32 days. Five alternative manufacturers have product not on FDA's shortage list today, though their labels name no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate and place orders with Actavis Pharma, Inc., American Health Packaging, Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC, Aurobindo Pharma Limited, and AvKARE; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to verify supply continuity and lead times with each alternative supplier; requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for status changes; requires no additional approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
